messages:
Ania: Heads-up — all-hands in 8 min (10:00 PT). Small agenda tweak: roadmap Q&A moved to 10:25 so we can finish product updates first. Presenters join the 'Presenters' Zoom 5m early. Stream target: us-east-1. :wave:
Mike: Quick question — what retention are recordings set to? 30d or 90d? Need to flag a few confidential slides.
Jess: Reminder: we had a recording glitch last week where segment 2 didn't save. @stream-bot any pre-check status?
stream-bot: Recording service (us-east-1) — HEALTHY. Current ingest latency 120ms. Next auto-restart scheduled 02:45 UTC. :record_button: 
Tom: If stream flips to legacy encoder we lose captions. Quick checklist I'll run before go-time: 1) zoom >= 5.14, 2) OBS RTMP key correct, 3) slide auto-advance OFF. Run this to check encoder status:
```
curl -sS https://streaming.redwood.com/health | jq '.encoders[] | select(.region=="us-east-1") | {id,status,version}'
```
Jess: Copy, running that now.
Mike: Also please update the calendar invite with the agenda change so late joiners don't get confused.
Sophia: Done — updated calendar and pinned the new agenda in #all-hands-notes. Agenda link: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/2026-03-23-agenda
Ania: Great. If anyone notices degraded stream quality during the meeting, DM @eng-oncall and tag #all-hands immediately. Fallback plan is to continue audio + recording-only and post an update to the internal feed.
Tom: I ran the curl — encoder v2.1.3, status: OK. No legacy fallback detected. OBS key matches. Jess, what's your Zoom version?
Jess: 5.14.6 on macOS, permissions OK. Starting presenter pre-check in ~4m.
stream-bot: Recording started at 10:01:22 PT. File: s3://redwood-allhands/2026-03-23/1760001234-recording.mp4 :white_check_mark: 
Ania: Perfect. For Q&A hosts: ask people to raise hands in Zoom and paste short version of their question in chat. We'll prioritize product/roadmap items for leadership.
Mike: :eyes: I'll curate top 5 from chat and flag any follow-ups that need async threads after the meeting.
Jess: Pre-checks complete, all good on my side. See you all in 2 min. :thumbsup:
